title: The daily off-site copy has no tooling yet
remediation: Owner decision d (D-81) requires a daily copy of the Longhorn backup target and the write-once audit archive to a write-once store at your organization's second site, and the backup runbook describes a sterling-offsite CronJob and offsite.mjs pack and verify for it. Neither exists yet; plan 47-33 builds them. Until then a site has no automated off-site copy: your organization makes the copy by its own means and records each one. This closes when 47-33 lands the CronJob, offsite.mjs pack and verify, and their tests, and a lab run copies and verifies one day's set.

milestones.title: Build the sterling-offsite CronJob and offsite.mjs pack and verify (47-33), with their tests
Copy and verify one day's set to a write-once store at a second site on the lab, and record it
